title: Chapter 509
paragraphs: Chapter 509
Episode 141. Fall (2)
Thud!
Mon fell to one knee and coughed up a mouthful of blood. If he had exchanged just a few more blows, he would have met his death by the sword of that monstrous demon.

'...I've heard that there are some incredibly strong demons active right now, but I didn't know that one of them belonged to Kinzelo. I wonder if the 1st generation had a demon like that in the past.'

It had been a long time since he had been defeated so helplessly and disregarded. Although he managed to recover his severed left arm, it would be difficult for him to continue his mission as a Dark Knight without receiving treatment at the level of the Holy King.
However, this was not the time to be overwhelmed by feelings of despair.

'The demon is heading towards the signal in Lomin Forest. The Grenil ship is also flying towards Lomin Forest, and judging by the fact that Cojec is following it... there is a possibility that Jane and the other generations are there as well.'

Mon did not know the exact situation in Lomin Forest. However, he knew that there must be a reason for the forces of Zipfel and Kinzelo to gather, and the most important thing in this incident was the items in the 2nd Tower's vault.
'Did the 2nd generation succeed in retrieving them? Or did Kinzelo obtain them and the battle intensified...? Either way, my job is to request support.'
There was no point in trying to hold Bianca back. Even if she was an enemy's enemy, he had to do everything he could to ensure the success of his mission.
He treated his wounds and moved on.

The border guards were on high alert. The long stone walls that formed the border were lit with lights from the watchtowers. The border guards from the five autonomous districts and eight autonomous countries were more vigilant than ever, looking at their assigned areas, Lomin Forest, and the battlefield in Sota Desert in turn.
The Grenil ship and Octavia's forces were approaching Lomin Forest at an insane speed.
As the battle intensified, the border guards couldn't help but think that Lomin Forest might completely disappear from the map.

The commanders of the border sent search parties to the area where Mon and Bianca had fought. Although it wasn't as big a disturbance as the turmoil in Lomin Forest and Sota Desert, it wasn't something the border guards could overlook.
Mon moved through the border, finding gaps without being detected.
'Damn it, my body is starting to stiffen.'
He was bleeding too much. Like Jane earlier, Mon was also severely injured, and without the mental strength and willpower of a Dark Knight, he would have already lost consciousness.
He leaned against a tree for a moment, gasping for breath. His vision blurred with fever, and his bones creaked with every shiver.
In the midst of his weakened senses due to pain, Mon suddenly changed his posture and pointed his sword at the bushes.
He felt someone approaching.
'Is it a border guard...?!'

If it was a few people of 7th rank or lower, he could quietly handle them with his current condition. However, if it was any more than that, it would be impossible to kill everyone before they could fire a signal flare.
Moments later, when the owners of the approaching presence appeared, Mon was able to let out a sigh of relief.
"Mon!"
It was Jin and his party who appeared from the bushes.

The paths available to avoid the border surveillance were extremely limited. Jin's group had also followed the same route as Mon, and had seen his trail of blood along the way. Thus, their encounter was more inevitable than coincidental.
"The 12th generation."
"What happened... Damn, your arm."
"What about the mission? Why are you alone? What about Jane and the 2nd generation?"
As Mon spoke, he paused and met the dark and heavy gazes of Jin's group.
"…We escaped Lomin Forest thanks to Jane's sacrifice."
Mon was silent for a few seconds before looking back towards the direction of Lomin Forest, where his lover had met her death.
After becoming a Dark Knight, he had given up on his personal life, but Mon and Jane had always believed that their hearts were connected.
They had planned to spend the rest of their lives together if they managed to retire safely.
That hope had come to an end.
"I see."
Mon replied with a calm voice.
As Jane had prioritized her family and mission over choosing her final words for her lover, so did he.
Petty grief wouldn't help their family. Dark Knights thought that way.
That was the black helmet of Runcandel.
"Did the 2nd generation survive as well?"
"Yes."

Mon didn't ask why it was the next head of the family, not another generation, who had survived, whether it was voluntary or involuntary, why Jin had the black sword Kainer, and how the 2nd generation was fighting without it.
He didn't ask because he felt like he knew the reason why Joshua had survived.
"Did you succeed in the retrieval?"
Jin took out the items from his pocket and showed them.
"If we can escape safely, the mission will be a success. It's better to discuss my injuries, Yona Runcandel, and Sandra Zipfel in detail after we escape. For now, let's move before I collapse."
Mon's gaze landed on Sandra. She was rummaging through her coat pocket, carefully searching for painkillers.
"Ah, luckily I have some left. Swallow this, it worked great on that sister earlier. It's hard to run if you're in pain, right?"
"…Sister? Are you talking about Jane, Sandra Zipfel?"
"Yes, she was grateful."
Mon silently took the painkiller and swallowed it. Then, he lightly patted Sandra's shoulder.
Although Mon didn't reveal their relationship, his companions seemed to somehow understand what he felt when he patted Sandra's shoulder.
They started moving again.
'It'll be difficult to just pass by without a clash of power.'
It was natural since they were in the heart of the Lutero Magic Federation and the surveillance network was several times denser than usual.
As they were considering which way would be the most efficient to break through, Sandra spoke up.
"Haah, I guess it's time to end our first date."
All eyes were on Sandra.
She was biting her lower lip, trying to soothe her disappointment.
"Now I need to step in so Jin can escape. From now on, even if I want to see you, I can't come like this. Today, Jin, you were really close to the end, right?"
Jin and Sandra's eyes met.
"I'll distract the guards' attention. In the meantime, escape without getting caught. But remember what we talked about earlier?"

-However, it's true that thanks to you, the brothers and Dark Knights have saved their lives, so I'd like to pay you back in some way. If you need anything, ask for it. If it's something I can do, I'll do it after we escape.
Jin and Sandra recalled the words at the same time.
"What do you need?"
Sandra held out the golden prosthetic arm to Jin, making sure that the image of his face engraved on the inside of the forearm was clearly visible.
"I'd like you to engrave your name under this picture."

"Wow... you really are the best. There's this girl, Enya. She's the president of the little fan club, but she can't compare to you. I don't think I'll ever see someone like you again, even if I live for three thousand more years."

"I'm the official fan club president, you know? After the Golden Wing advertisement, all sorts of messy fan clubs sprung up, but I created and passed fan activity laws and even officially registered. There should have been a few articles about it too, on Huphester's side."
"Oh, I think I've seen that. Nodav Sarsein, someone with a name like that, right?"
"That's my alias. So what Enya does is just her own fan play, while I do official fan activities. There's a difference in class."
Jin silently pulled out his dagger and signed as she requested under the picture on the prosthetic arm.
Sandra nearly let out a scream but managed to stop herself.
"Wow! I'll treasure this more than my life!"

She didn't know how to express the feeling of having her Ben Arm turn into a golden prosthetic, with her face engraved on it, and a signature below it, and even hearing that she'd treasure it more than her life... There were no words.
Anyway, the moment he finished signing.
Krrrrr...!
Suddenly, a massive explosion occurred in Lomin Forest.
The explosion was so massive that it could be felt even from the central demarcation line. Moreover, the explosion was not caused by Kinselona Zipfel.
It was an explosion caused by the decisive device of Runcandel. The group could all tell at once.
The family's only self-destruct device, a sword made with the utmost end in mind.
It was the 7th decisive device, Volcano. Just as he had done against Jin and Garmund in the Blue Bird Army Road, Joshua chose the volcano as his last resort using duplication.
At that time, Joshua's volcano demonstrated enough power to completely erase the 32nd island of the Blue Bird Army Road. The volcano, now enhanced by Taki, far surpassed the power of that time.
The aura mixed with Taki soared into the sky and fell to the ground, destroying Lomin Forest. It was quite literally the sight of a massive volcano exploding.
From where the group stood, the distortion and breaking of space and sky in the Lomin Forest area were clearly visible due to the shock.
The ships urgently deployed their protective shields to the maximum, and the strong ones exerted their utmost effort to save allies who could not withstand the explosion.
"It seems like they're shooting celebratory cannons to congratulate the birth of my treasure number one on the other side!"
Sandra, seemingly unbothered by the fact that the volcano was destroying her family's territory, cheerfully shouted.
"Let's go now, Mr. Jin. Thanks to that explosion, the guards seem to be momentarily stunned, so if I act a little surprised, there will be a hole in the surveillance."
"Sandra Zipfel."
"Yes!"

-But still, Jin. I have a sense of responsibility. If the family is going down the wrong path, shouldn't I correct it? I will normalize everything. I will bring Zipfel back to the proud family I knew.
-That's a story that lacks realism.
-If you guys help, there's nothing we can't do.
-Apart from us being friends, what's wrong is wrong. Runcandel helping Zipfel is impossible.
Suddenly.
Jin saw a friend's face in her for a moment. He recalled the conversation they had at Veradin's villa. Leaving the family behind and abandoning the name Zipfel. He remembered the moment he said that.
"It would be great if you could send my regards to Veradin."
"Hey, I was going to hold your hand... I was thinking of talking to Ladin about Mr. Jin."
As Jin reached out his hand, Sandra's eyes widened. Of course, it was not to fulfill Sandra's request, but to request a handshake from the position of having received great help in this matter.
"See you again, Mr. Jin."
"Take care, Sandra."
As soon as she turned around and left the bushes, Sandra yelled like this when she encountered the guards.
"I am Sandra Zipfel, the acting owner of the White Night Tower. The intruders are fleeing towards the 16th guard post, so pursue them quickly!"
While the guards followed Sandra's command and moved,
Runcandel was finally able to cross the demarcation line and escape the center of the Ruteiro Magic Federation through the West Sea.
